name: ctrack-publish-web-hybrid
description: CTrack Publish hybrid monorepo: lightweight local engine + web UI

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.CTRACK_SKIP_POSTINSTALL_RUNTIME==='1')process.exit(0)" && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 -w engine && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/ensure-engine-runtime.ps1 -TargetRoot engine && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/provision-gui-python.ps1 -TargetRoot engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,engine -c blue,green "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w engine"
scripts.build: npm run build -w engine && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web --if-present && npm run lint -w engine --if-present
